verses.en: O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Agradecei ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom, porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Agradecei ao Deus dos deuses, porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Give thanks to the God of gods; for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: O give praise to the God of gods: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Agradecei ao SENHOR dos senhores; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Give thanks to the Lord of lords; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.en_bbe: O give praise to the Lord of lords: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Ao que faz grandes maravilhas sozinho por si mesmo; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: To him who alone does great wonders; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.en_bbe: To him who only does great wonders: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Ao que fez os céus com entendimento; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: To him who by understanding made the heavens; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.en_bbe: To him who by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Ao que estendeu a terra sobre as águas; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: To him who spread out the earth above the waters; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.en_bbe: To him by whom the earth was stretched out over the waters: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.pt: Ao que fez as grandes fontes de luz; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: To him who made the great lights; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.en_bbe: To him who made great lights: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.pt: Ao sol, para governar o dia; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: The sun to rule by day; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.en_bbe: The sun to have rule by day: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: À lua e as estrelas, para governarem a noite; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: The moon and stars to rule by night; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.en_bbe: The moon and the stars to have rule by night: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.pt: Ao que feriu aos egípcios em seus primogênitos; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: To him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.en_bbe: To him who put to death the first-fruits of Egypt: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

verses.en: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.pt: E tirou Israel do meio deles; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: And brought out Israel from among them; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.en_bbe: And took out Israel from among them: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

verses.en: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Com mão forte, e com braço estendido; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.en_bbe: With a strong hand and an outstretched arm: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.pt: Ao que separou o mar Vermelho em duas partes; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: To him who divided the Red Sea apart; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.en_bbe: To him who made a way through the Red Sea: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

verses.en: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.pt: E fez Israel passar por meio dele; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: And made Israel to pass through the middle of it; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.en_bbe: And let Israel go through it: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

verses.en: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: E derrubou a Faraó com seu exército no mar Vermelho; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: But overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.en_bbe: By him Pharaoh and his army were overturned in the Red Sea: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Ao que guiou seu povo pelo deserto; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: To him who led his people through the wilderness; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.en_bbe: To him who took his people through the waste land: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.pt: Ao que feriu grandes reis; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: To him who struck great kings; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.en_bbe: To him who overcame great kings: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

verses.en: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.pt: E matou reis poderosos; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: And killed mighty kings; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.en_bbe: And put noble kings to death: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

verses.en: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.pt: Seom; rei amorreu; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Sihon king of the Amorites; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.en_bbe: Sihon, king of the Amorites: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

verses.en: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.pt: E Ogue, rei de Basã; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Og king of Bashan; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.en_bbe: And Og, king of Bashan: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:

verses.en: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.pt: E deu a terra deles como herança; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: And gave their land as an inheritance; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.en_bbe: And gave their land to his people for a heritage: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Como herança a seu servo Israel; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Even a heritage to Israel his servant; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.en_bbe: Even a heritage for his servant Israel: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:
verses.pt: O que em nossa humilhação se lembrou de nós; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Who remembered us in our low estate; for his loving kindness endures forever;
verses.en_bbe: Who kept us in mind when we were in trouble: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: E nos tirou livres de nossos adversários; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: And has delivered us from our adversaries; for his loving kindness endures forever:
verses.en_bbe: And has taken us out of the hands of our haters: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: O que dá alimento a todo ser vivo feito de carne; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Who gives food to every creature; for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: Who gives food to all flesh: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.

verses.en: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Agradecei ao Deus dos céus; porque sua bondade dura para sempre.
verses.en_web: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven; for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: O give praise to the God of heaven: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
